title: Cows, Carbon and Climate | Joel Salatin | TEDxCharlottesville
summary: Farmer Joel Salatin gives a TEDx talk on how well-managed grass and rotational grazing support sustainable farming and affect the climate. He draws on his work at Polyface Farm in Virginia.
why: HN cites it in climate and diet debates as a contrarian perspective that cattle on managed pasture can be part of the solution.

quote.text: Highly recommend Joel Salatin's works - he has a really interesting perspective.
